rationale: SS is explicitly named in advanced/unresectable sarcoma eligibility after standard-treatment failure or where no standard exists.
cohort_reconciliation: CAV/IE with or without toripalimab; an additional maintenance randomization is described only for experimental-arm disease control. First-line exceptions for subtypes lacking standard therapy do not establish first-line SS access.

protocol_uncertainty: Age 14–70 and clinical restrictions apply. External protocol, exact regimen and live slots are unverified; no source novelty or efficacy claim is endorsed.
quotes: Patients who had previously received anti-PD-1 / PD-L1 antibody therapy.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: SS is explicitly included in the advanced/unresectable STS list.
cohort_reconciliation: Single cadonilimab/anlotinib arm after at least one chemotherapy regimen including anthracycline and documented progression within six months. Acinar soft-tissue and clear-cell sarcoma exceptions do not apply to SS. Prior immune therapy is excluded; prior anlotinib is conditionally excluded for best PD or SD no longer than twelve weeks.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular entry gate is stated.
protocol_uncertainty: Age at least 18 and clinical/washout restrictions remain. Drug spelling varies between cadonilimab and candonilimab in the source; external protocol and live availability are unreviewed. No individual treatment eligibility or benefit is established.
quotes: Patients who have used at least one chemotherapy regimen (including anthracyclines) in the past (except for acinar soft tissue sarcoma and clear cell sarcoma)
The best swelling evaluation result of patients who had received previous treatment with anlotinib was PD, or SD ≤ 12 weeks.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: SS is explicitly among the confirmed diagnoses eligible for MDG1015 after exhaustion of options with proven survival benefit.
cohort_reconciliation: Dose escalation followed by expansion shares the listed disease scope. Adult weight threshold differs between dose levels 1–3 (40 kg) and level 4 (50 kg). GAC/GEJ-specific resection exclusion is not an SS condition.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Central HLA-A*02:01 positivity and NY-ESO-1 and/or LAGE-1a mRNA positivity are required. HLA-A*02:02 and *02:03 are excluded. Numerical expression cutoff is absent from the saved text; eligible archival tissue must be no older than one year, or a fresh biopsy may be used.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and assay thresholds are unreviewed. Saved status is NOT_YET_RECRUITING with a 2024 verification date, not evidence of live availability. Clinical criteria, leukapheresis and organ requirements remain; no efficacy or safety conclusion follows.
quotes: Subject's must have tested positive for HLA-A\*02:01 genotype by a Sponsor designated central laboratory
Subject's tumor must have tested positive for NY-ESO-1 and/or LAGE-1a mRNA expression by a Sponsor designated central laboratory
